page: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-1t is a specialized accelerator instance within the ct5p family. It features 52 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 112.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.15 GB per vCPU. The primary hardware accelerator is a single Google TPU v5p with 95 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The hardware profile is optimized for workloads requiring high-density tensor processing rather than massive system memory capacity, as the system RAM is relatively constrained compared to the compute and accelerator resources.

The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is tied to its specialized TPU hardware. By pairing a Google TPU v5p with a moderate system memory footprint, it targets workloads that can offload heavy matrix multiplication and deep learning operations directly to the accelerator. This configuration is designed for machine learning training, large-scale model inference, and data science pipelines that utilize TPU-optimized frameworks.
